name: Emory Pre-College Program
what_you_do: You take a college course taught by Emory faculty. It runs two to four weeks in summer. You can choose residential or commuter. A 3-week Pre-Med Institute is offered. So are 6-week credit courses.
who_can_apply: High school students; the page says it serves current sophomores and juniors. Application needs transcript and recommendations.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: 2-week noncredit course $5,510 residential or $3,925 commuter; 3-week institute $8,264 residential; 4 weeks $11,020. $70 application fee. 2027 prices not posted.
duration: 2 to 6 weeks (2027 noncredit sessions June 13 to 26, June 27 to July 10, July 11 to 24)
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 open in December 2026. Deadlines: noncredit sessions May 3, 2027; Pre-Med Institute Feb 1, 2027; credit Summer College April 20 and June 7, 2027.
how_to_apply: Choose a program and course, review costs, then start the online application (transcript, recommendations, $70 fee). After acceptance, complete the pre-arrival checklist and pay the $350 enrollment deposit.
notes: Expensive. The nearest deadline is the Pre-Med Institute on Feb 1, 2027 (deadline_iso shows the main May 3 date). Financial aid deadline was May 1 in 2026. Information sessions are in November and December 2026.
